build_bert_model: build a BertModel instance for extracting hidden-state representations from input text sequences
create_bert_sequence_classification: create a BertForSequenceClassification model for GLUE task fine-tuning with a classification head
run_bert_masked_lm: run a BertForMaskedLM model for masked language modeling pre-training objectives
test_bert_question_answering: test a BertForQuestionAnswering model for extractive QA span prediction on SQuAD-style tasks
review_bert_token_classification: review a BertForTokenClassification model for named-entity recognition token-level predictions

refactor_load_tf_weights: refactor the load_tf_weights_in_bert function to convert TensorFlow checkpoint weights into PyTorch
